item.title: Distros — Rocky Linux 10
item.description: If you want the RHEL 10 userland on RISC-V without touching a Red Hat account, the riscv64 container images of Rocky 10 are the ready-to-use option today; running a real system still means waiting for installation media. ｜ Based on RHEL 10 (CentOS Stream 10 code base)
